LanguageData.Contagion_DifficultyEasierTooltip: Diseases spread more slowly and spread suppression is stronger, so outbreaks rarely reach the whole colony. Good for a more forgiving game.
LanguageData.Contagion_DifficultyNormalTooltip: Balanced transmission with moderate spread suppression: outbreaks are dangerous but a well-run colony can usually contain them.
LanguageData.Contagion_DifficultyHarderTooltip: Faster, more realistic spread with NO spread suppression. An untreated outbreak can sweep through the entire colony. For experienced players.
LanguageData.Contagion_SeedingModeStorytellerTooltip: Vanilla storyteller disease picks are intercepted and converted into Contagion start requests that resolve through arrivals, animal contact, environmental windows, or an acausal fallback.
LanguageData.Contagion_SeedingModeContagionTooltip: Contagion owns disease pacing directly. Storyteller disease incidents for profiled diseases are cancelled and continuous start chances are tuned by the disease director.
LanguageData.Contagion_SettingMaskProtection: Masks and lungs reduce airborne spread
LanguageData.Contagion_SettingMaskProtectionTooltip: When enabled, worn masks (e.g. gas masks) and air-filtering body parts (detoxifier/fleshmass lungs) reduce airborne, social, and close-contact transmission for the wearer and those nearby, based on their Toxic Environment Resistance. Genes are ignored by default; specific genes (like breathless) can grant airway immunity via the Contagion_RespiratoryImmunity def.
LanguageData.Contagion_SettingTransmissionRateTooltip: Global multiplier applied to transmission vector chances.
LanguageData.Contagion_SettingOutbreakFrequencyToolti: Global multiplier applied to continuous seeding timers and arrival-seeding chances where the current mode uses them.
LanguageData.Contagion_SettingIncubationLengthTooltip: Global multiplier applied to incubation duration before the real disease appears.
LanguageData.Contagion_DiagnosticsModeOffTooltip: Disable Contagion runtime counters and optional tracing.
LanguageData.Contagion_DiagnosticsModeSummaryTooltip: Collect lightweight counters for disease incidence, spread, and blocked application outcomes.
LanguageData.Contagion_DiagnosticsModeVerboseTooltip: Enable event-level tracing for debugging. Traces should remain gated behind dev mode.
LanguageData.Contagion_DiagnosticsModeDeveloperToolti: Enable developer-only contagion debugging tools such as forced arrivals, pawn seeding gizmos, hover breakdowns, and trace overlays.
LanguageData.Contagion_ShowPerformanceStatsTooltip: Track transmission tick timings and candidate counts while diagnostics are enabled.
LanguageData.Contagion_DiagnosticsPending: Runtime counters and trace summaries will appear here once the contagion engine is implemented.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperDiagnosticsNoMap: Developer tools only appear while a colony map is open.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperDiagnosticsUnavailabl: Developer tools are unavailable because the current map has no Contagion runtime component.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperForcedArrivalNone: No forced arrival override is armed.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperForceArrivalRequiresC: Force-next-arrival only works while Seeding mode is set to Contagion.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperForceArrivalNoDisease: No arrival-capable disease profiles are configured.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperTraceCaptureDesc: Toggle developer contagion trace capture and rendering for this map.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperSeedDiseaseDesc: Developer tool: choose a disease profile and seed its incubation on this pawn using the normal Contagion incubation path.
LanguageData.Contagion_DeveloperClearPawnTracesDesc: Remove stored contagion transmission traces where this pawn is the source or target.

LanguageData.Contagion_LetterOutbreakFirstCase: {0} is showing symptoms of {1}. This is the first visible case in the colony, but transmission may already be underway.
LanguageData.Contagion_LetterAnimalOutbreakFirstCase: {0} is showing signs of {1}. This disease can also spread to your colonists, slaves, and prisoners — consider isolating infected animals or disposing of them safely before butchering.
LanguageData.Contagion_LetterExposureSingle: {0} has been exposed to {1}. Symptoms may appear after an incubation period.
LanguageData.Contagion_LetterExposureMultiple: {0} pawns have been exposed to {1}. Symptoms may appear after an incubation period
LanguageData.Contagion_LetterTraitDisease: {0} is feeling unwell. Their poor immune system has caught something, and symptoms may appear after an incubation period. Consider isolating them as a precaution.
LanguageData.Contagion_MessageButcherNoticed: {0} noticed signs of infection while butchering {1} ({2}) and discarded all the products.
LanguageData.Contagion_AnimalSickDetected: {0} noticed that {1} seems unwell. A vet should examine the animal.
LanguageData.Contagion_LetterAnimalDiagnosed: {0} examined {1} and diagnosed {2}. The animal should not be butchered while infected — its carcass will be unsafe unless the disease is treated first.
LanguageData.Contagion_MessageAnimalExamClear: {0} examined {1} and found nothing of concern.
LanguageData.Contagion_GizmoSlaughterDisposeDesc: Slaughter this animal and mark the carcass for disposal. Use when you suspect disease and do not want to risk butchering.
LanguageData.Contagion_GizmoSlaughterButcherDesc: Slaughter this animal and allow butchering despite the sick signal. Contaminated meat may infect whoever cooks or eats it.
